desc: Where it started. My first portfolio, built mostly to learn the basics and get something live under my own name. I use this to get an internship at my campus
The React rebuild, aiming at a future/urban look and my first real attempt at motion on the web. Use this to get a job at my first company, eventually i got an offer from them.

Where you are now. Currently the AI is running the world. Kinda sad since not much job left for us. Yet i learned a lot from my current company with AI as tools. Becoming a better engineer and designer. I hope this portfolio can be a good showcase of my skills and experience.
